vulnerability_type: Denial of Service via Restricted Mode

preconditions.description: Contract must be in Restricted state (bot protection enabled)
Attacker must have at least 1 wei of BNRG tokens to initiate a transfer

exploit_hint: When contract is in Restricted state, the launchRestrict modifier updates lastTx for both sender and recipient to block.timestamp. By transferring a small amount to a victim address, you can set their lastTx timestamp, preventing them from making transactions for 60 seconds. Repeatedly target the same victim address with small transfers to keep their lastTx updated, effectively blocking their ability to transact.
